mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, group_link_id, status, trigger_source, attempt_count, next_run_at, lease_until, execution_account_id, rerun_requested, last_started_at, last_success_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_metadata_sync_task ( group_link_id, status, trigger_source, attempt_count, next_run_at, rerun_requested, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.groupLinkId}, #{row.status}, #{row.triggerSource}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextRunAt}, FALSE, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trigger_source = VALUES(trigger_source), attempt_count = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN attempt_count ELSE 0 END, next_run_at = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN next_run_at ELSE VALUES(next_run_at) END, lease_until = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN lease_until ELSE NULL END, execution_account_id = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN execution_account_id ELSE NULL END, rerun_requested = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END, last_error_message = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN last_error_message ELSE NULL END, status = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN status ELSE VALUES(status) END, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM group_metadata_sync_task WHERE group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET status = #{row.status}, next_run_at = #{row.nextRunAt}, lease_until = NULL, execution_account_id = NULL, rerun_requested = FALSE, last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{row.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE status = #{runningStatus} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{row.updatedAt}

UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET status = #{row.status}, next_run_at = #{row.nextRunAt}, lease_until = NULL, execution_account_id = NULL, rerun_requested = FALSE, last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{row.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE status = #{runningStatus} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{row.updatedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT task.id FROM group_metadata_sync_task task WHERE task.status = #{deferredStatus} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_link link INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND binding.group_id = link.group_id AND binding.account_id = #{accountId} INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 WHERE link.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND link.id = task.group_link_id AND link.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY task.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task task SET task.status = #{pendingStatus}, task.trigger_source = #{triggerSource}, task.next_run_at = #{now}, task.rerun_requested = FALSE, task.last_error_code = NULL, task.last_error_message = NULL, task.updated_at = #{now} WHERE task.status = #{deferredStatus} AND task.id IN #{id}
